# Radoslav Radev Requires 15 Pull-Ups, 20 Dips And 30 Push-Ups Before Planche, Front Lever And Handstand Skills

Radoslav Radev requires a minimum of 15 pull-ups, 20 dips, and 30 push-ups with good form as a foundation before attempting planche, front lever, handstand, or handstand push-ups. [src: vid-3EcXfOgjk1o @ 00:44]

## Details

- Before even thinking about skills like planche, front lever, handstand, or handstand push-ups, you need a base of minimum 15 pull-ups, 20 dips, and 30 push-ups with good form. [src: vid-3EcXfOgjk1o @ 00:44]
- When you reach these numbers, you are ready. [src: vid-3EcXfOgjk1o @ 01:06]
- If you do not have this foundation, your muscles are not ready and your joints will take the stress, which is where injury starts. [src: vid-3EcXfOgjk1o @ 00:55]
- He says this number is enough preparation; if you have it, it is enough, and if you do not have it, it is a potential reason for injury. [src: vid-3EcXfOgjk1o @ 01:19]

## Evidence

- vid-3EcXfOgjk1o @ 00:44 (Radoslav Radev): "before you even think about skills like planche, front lever, handstand, or handstand push-ups, you need a base. Minimum 15 pull-ups, 20 dips, and 30 push-ups with good form."
- vid-3EcXfOgjk1o @ 00:55 (Radoslav Radev): "If you don't have this, your muscles are not ready and your joints will take the stress. And this is where the injury starts."
- vid-3EcXfOgjk1o @ 01:06 (Radoslav Radev): "Start with the pull-ups, dips, the push-ups, and when you reach these numbers, you're ready."
- vid-3EcXfOgjk1o @ 01:19 (Radoslav Radev): "this number is really good preparation and if you have it, it's enough. If you don't have it, this is potential reason for injury."

## Why This Matters

He says that without this foundation, your joints take the stress instead of your muscles, and that is where injury starts. [src: vid-3EcXfOgjk1o @ 00:55]

- [[Radoslav Radev Requires A Minimum 10-Second Hold Before Progressing To The Next Planche Or Front Lever Step]] — the next rule after the foundation is met.
